    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [
        (logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'),
        (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'),
        (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call'),
    ]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):

        if arr.ndim != 2:

        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:

        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")

    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float, np.floating)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a numeric type")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized decreasing future-token weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = raw_weights.sum()
    if weight_sum <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Future horizon too small (weight sum non-positive)")
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum

    # Compute weighted future-token loss for each condition
    def compute_weighted_loss(logp_matrix: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return -np.sum(logp_matrix * normalized_weights, axis=1)

    margin = L_minus - L_with_result
